quantize_params_int4: quantize model parameters using INT4 per-channel quantization with the quantize function
quantize_params_int8: quantize model parameters using INT8 per-channel quantization with the quantize function
uniform_quantize_array: apply uniform quantization to a JAX array with specified bitwidth and granularity
reduce_max_axis: reduce the maximum value of an array over all dimensions except one specified axis
replace_nested_keys: replace intermediate keys in a nested dictionary structure recursively
